name: Epidemius
canonNotes: The Tallyman of Nurgle, a Plaguebearer who counts every disease and infection spread in Nurgle's name.
Obsessive and meticulous; each tally brings the Garden closer.
voiceNotes: Monotone, obsessive and bureaucratic; counts things, cites numbers.
Values order in rot; little warmth.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
